correctness.rationale: Partition each shore by initial color and cap its multiplicities at 2; each initial color class remains synchronized at every future step, and the threshold-two neighbor predicate depends exclusively on the capped counts. Thus 23 attainable profiles per shore, 529 pairs, form an exact symbolic factor for every a,b>=2. The complete deterministic recurrence has period classes 476 fixed, 52 period-four, one period-three; maximum preperiod five. Independent reimplementation of the cap-update and signature recurrence obtains the same classes and the exact U,A,Q,H period-four coefficient matrix [[6,6,3,3],[6,6,3,3],[3,3,2,1],[3,3,1,0]]. Exact multinomial counts of each initial profile produce B3=H_aH_b and displayed B4 formula, and initial period-four states are only profiles (202,220),(220,202), producing U_a U_b/2 orbits. Every profile with 2 as a cap is realized by arbitrarily many vertices, so the 529-case exhaustion is a genuine all-shore-size proof, not extrapolation.
residual_risks: Independent check confirms quotient dynamics and coefficient classification but does not independently re-enumerate 1.3 million individual graph states; the exact quotient preserves threshold-two semantics.

broader_coverage.reasoning: General oscillatory media theory does not specify the finite complete-bipartite tagged color dynamics, count all labelled basins by multinomial profiles or establish F^17=F^5 for this threshold-two model.

final_claim: For synchronous threshold-two three-state Greenberg–Hastings on K_{a,b} (a,b>=2), exact capped 529-profile quotient gives all eventual periods {1,3,4}, entrance by time five and full period-basin polynomials, with 4-cycle iff a,b>=4 and 3-cycle iff a,b>=6.
limitations: Synchronous threshold exactly two, three states, complete bipartite graph, a,b>=2; uses exhaustive *exact finite quotient*, not purely empirical finite-size tests.
